exactPassages: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. On the Claude Platform, developers can get started with claude-opus-5-5.
Input and output tokens are $4 and $20 per million, 20% less than Opus 5. Cache reads (which make up the majority of agentic and coding work costs) are $0.20 per million tokens, 60% less than Opus 5.

In addition to the price drop, we’re increasing five-hour usage limits on Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans. We’re also providing subscription users a rate limit reset, which you can now save and use whenever you choose.
Fast mode for Opus 5.5 is also available in Claude Code and the Claude Platform with up to 2.5x speed. It costs $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
Opus 5.5 is particularly good at long and sprawling jobs like codebase-wide migrations and audits.
We’re introducing Claude Opus 5.5, the first model in our new Claude 5.5 family. It performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.
sourceLimitations: The page is Anthropic's own announcement; performance, speed, safety, and cost-per-task comparisons are provider claims unless independently reproduced.
'All platforms' supports broad platform availability, but the page does not explicitly map model-selector eligibility for each individual Claude subscription plan.
The token prices are developer/API prices. They are not monthly Claude subscription prices.
The higher five-hour limits and saved reset are stated for subscription users, but the page does not quantify the new limits or say that every subscription tier receives identical access.
